package probe

import "os/exec"

// -exec replaces the program the go command runs for a step, with the
// environment of the go command, so the exemption covers no such argument.
func toolchainExec() error {
	build := exec.Command("go", "build", "-exec", "sh", "./cmd/x")
	return build.Run()
}

func toolchainExecEqual() error {
	list := exec.Command("go", "list", "--exec=/bin/sh")
	_, err := list.Output()
	return err
}
